text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urine analysis shows significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL Enterococcus faecalis), leukocyturia, nitrites, hematuria, and positive leukocyte esterase, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Presence of glucose in urine and low specific gravity may warrant further evaluation for glycosuria and renal concentrating ability. No casts or ketones detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
